authority_statement: Evaluator judgments are advisory. Only the Product Team may decide Product meaning; completing this packet does not publish semantics.

items.candidate_capability: Companion record identity and update safeguards
items.candidate_basis: Bound create and update handlers call duplicate-name and update paths, while owner association and validator nodes are present; four linked delivery episodes exercise duplicate-name behavior, persisted association, name validation, and update regression coverage.

evaluator_judgments.suggested_name: Pet identity validation and update safeguards
evaluator_judgments.notes: The cited handlers and validator support duplicate-name and update safeguards, but the proposed boundary combines several behaviors and overlaps broader pet registration and maintenance candidates. Human Product Team authority remains required for the final boundary.
limitations: Cross-file convergence depends on delivery co-change rather than graph edges.
The supplied evidence does not establish that creation, update, identity, and validation form one Product capability.
unsupported_claims: That all cited creation, ownership, validation, and update behavior is one complete realization.

evaluator_judgments.suggested_name: Pet registration safeguards; Pet update safeguards
evaluator_judgments.notes: The create and update handlers directly support duplicate-name and update safeguards, and owner and validator references add relevant corroboration. The proposed capability is nevertheless composite: registration identity checks and maintenance safeguards have distinct flows, while the packet explicitly leaves their Product boundary unresolved. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: Cross-file cohesion relies on shared delivery episodes rather than graph edges.
Database uniqueness behavior and tests are not represented as graph nodes.
The evidence does not settle a single Product capability boundary.
unsupported_claims: A single complete capability spanning creation, update, ownership association, and validation is not established by the supplied evidence.

items.candidate_basis: Pet creation methods, owner aggregation, pet attribute mutators, and pet-type lookup form a coherent structural candidate for adding a typed, named, dated pet to an owner.

evaluator_judgments.notes: The creation methods, owner aggregation, pet attributes, and type lookup are coherent evidence for registration. Acceptance is evaluator-only because successful end-to-end registration is not demonstrated.
limitations: The graph does not prove persistence, transaction completion, or UI binding.
unsupported_claims: That the supplied structure alone proves a complete successful registration realization.

evaluator_judgments.notes: Creation-form handlers, owner aggregation, pet attribute mutators, and type lookup align closely with registering a pet. The capability label is concise and the referenced structure is appropriately scoped, subject to the stated runtime and UI gaps. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: No graph edge proves the transaction joining controller, owner, pet, and type repository.
UI binding and persistence success are outside the supplied evidence.
unsupported_claims: Successful persistence and end-to-end form binding are not proven by the supplied graph evidence.

items.candidate_basis: The graph connects list display to pagination and exposes resource-list, repository-list, collection, and specialty-access nodes; delivery history co-changed the directory components for pagination and later refined specialty ordering and controller representation handling.

evaluator_judgments.suggested_name: Veterinarian directory browsing and specialty review
evaluator_judgments.notes: Directory browsing and specialty presentation have related evidence but are independently describable behaviors. The combined capability is less precise than separate browse-directory and specialty-review candidates.
limitations: The broad pagination delivery episode weakens boundary precision.
Neither HTML nor serialized presentation is represented in the graph.
unsupported_claims: That pagination, serialized listing, and specialty presentation constitute one complete realization.
That specialty names are visibly presented.

evaluator_judgments.notes: The packet supports veterinarian listing, pagination, repository retrieval, collection access, and specialty access. Combining directory browsing, specialty presentation, and resource representation into one capability reduces boundary precision; the evidence is clearer as two candidate capabilities. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: The broad pagination delivery episode weakens attribution to this boundary.
HTML and serialized representations are not graph nodes.
Maintenance and refactoring episodes do not independently prove user-facing behavior.
unsupported_claims: A single complete user-facing presentation boundary across paginated HTML and resource-list representations is not proven.

items.candidate_basis: The controller exposes find-form, find-processing, and paginated last-name search methods, while the repository exposes a matching last-name-prefix query. Together these are direct structural candidates for search and result navigation.

evaluator_judgments.notes: The find-form, processing, pagination, and repository prefix query provide a direct and precise structural candidate for finding owners. The complete user-visible result flow remains unproven.
limitations: Rendered result links and request mappings are not present in the graph.
unsupported_claims: That the complete rendered search and navigation experience is realized.

evaluator_judgments.notes: Find-form initialization and processing, paginated last-name search, and the matching repository query directly support an owner-search capability. The scope and domain terminology are precise despite missing presentation evidence. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: Rendered result links and request mappings are not exposed by the graph.
The packet does not prove end-to-end result navigation.
unsupported_claims: Visible pagination controls and successful navigation through rendered results are not proven.

items.candidate_basis: Visit creation and processing methods explicitly load a pet with a visit, while the Visit model exposes date and description mutation and Owner exposes visit aggregation.

evaluator_judgments.notes: The controller flow, pet loading, visit fields, and owner aggregation form strong structural evidence for recording a pet visit. Completeness is limited by absent persistence and validation evidence.
limitations: Persistence success and validation behavior are not demonstrated.
unsupported_claims: That visit submission is successfully persisted and validated end to end.

evaluator_judgments.notes: The controller's explicit new-visit flow, Visit date and description mutators, and owner visit aggregation converge tightly on recording a pet visit. The candidate is well named and bounded. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: Persistence success and validation behavior are not demonstrated.
The supplied evidence does not show the rendered visit form.
unsupported_claims: Successful persistence, validation, and user-visible confirmation are not proven.

items.candidate_basis: VetController exposes list and pagination methods, VetRepository exposes collection retrieval, and Vets exposes a list accessor, providing convergent structure for veterinarian browsing.

evaluator_judgments.notes: Controller list and pagination methods, repository retrieval, and the list accessor converge on veterinarian browsing. The user-visible browsing experience is not directly evidenced.
limitations: List presentation and navigation controls are outside the graph.
unsupported_claims: That the complete rendered browsing experience is realized.

evaluator_judgments.notes: List, pagination, repository retrieval, and collection-access references form a coherent and narrowly scoped veterinarian-browsing candidate. Presentation details remain unverified but do not undermine the structural realization. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: List presentation and navigation controls are outside the Java-only graph.
No runtime evidence confirms pagination behavior.
unsupported_claims: The exact visible list and pagination experience are not proven.

items.candidate_basis: The owner detail entry point, owner-to-pets accessor, pet-to-visits accessor, and visit display fields form a structural chain for reviewing visit history in owner and pet context.

evaluator_judgments.notes: The owner-to-pet-to-visit accessor chain supports retrieval of visit data in context. Calling it reviewable history exceeds the evidence unless presentation and ordering are verified.
limitations: No view evidence confirms that visits are rendered or ordered as history.
unsupported_claims: That visit entries are visibly rendered and ordered as a history.

evaluator_judgments.notes: Owner detail access, owner-to-pet traversal, pet-to-visit traversal, and visit fields support access to visit records. The stronger wording 'Review ... History' implies a presentation and ordering behavior that the supplied graph does not establish, so a narrower name is warranted. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: No view-template evidence confirms rendering or ordering as history.
The structural chain does not prove a dedicated review interaction.
unsupported_claims: A rendered, ordered visit-history experience is not proven.

items.candidate_basis: The bound graph contains visit date accessors and controller nodes for minimum-date calculation and new-visit processing; one focused pull request changed both Java components together to validate future dates.

evaluator_judgments.notes: The date accessors, minimum-date calculation, submission handler, and focused co-change support date validation. The proposed safeguards label is broader than the evidenced future-date check.
limitations: Only one delivery episode is supplied.
The extraction contains no cross-file entity-to-controller edge.
The exact exception policy and user wording are not evidenced.
unsupported_claims: That the evidence establishes a broader set of visit-date intake safeguards beyond the cited future-date behavior.
That the exact user-facing policy is established.

evaluator_judgments.notes: Date accessors, minimum-date calculation, visit processing, and a focused co-change provide good evidence for guarding visit-date intake. A more concrete label better reflects the evidenced future-date constraint without implying broader date-quality safeguards. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: Only one delivery episode supplies behavioral corroboration.
No cross-file graph edge joins Visit and VisitController.
The precise exception policy and user-facing wording are absent.
unsupported_claims: Broader visit-date validation rules beyond the future-date constraint are not established.

items.candidate_basis: WelcomeController.welcome is evidence for only the landing-page portion. Because the frozen capability also requires primary navigation and the Java-only graph contains no view or navigation nodes, the full capability cannot be mapped without exceeding the evidence boundary.

evaluator_judgments.notes: The packet correctly limits the controller evidence to the landing-page portion. Completing the proposed capability requires missing navigation and presentation evidence; no complete realization should be inferred.
limitations: The Java-only graph has no home template or primary-navigation links.

evaluator_judgments.suggested_name: Access Clinic Home and Primary Navigation
evaluator_judgments.notes: The welcome controller validly supports the landing-page portion and the proposal correctly declines to claim a complete realization. Completing the stated capability requires evidence for the home view and primary navigation. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: Only the landing-page controller is evidenced.
Home-template and primary-navigation nodes are absent from the Java-only graph.
unsupported_claims: Primary navigation availability and destinations are not supported by the supplied evidence.

items.candidate_capability: Client record search and result browsing
items.candidate_basis: The graph exposes a find-form path into paginated owner lookup and a repository prefix-search operation; delivery episodes added owner-list pagination and later corrected whitespace handling on the same controller path.

evaluator_judgments.notes: This candidate substantially duplicates BR-004: both cover owner record search plus paginated result browsing through the same controller and repository path. The owner terminology is closer to the supplied structural identifiers; final terminology remains a human Product Team decision.
limitations: The controller-to-repository association is not a direct graph edge.
Visible pagination is inferred rather than directly evidenced.
unsupported_claims: That visible pagination behavior is proven by the supplied Java graph.
That client record is the accepted Product term.

evaluator_judgments.notes: The structural and delivery evidence strongly supports owner search with paginated results, but this candidate overlaps the separately supplied Find Owners candidate. The delivery evidence is useful corroboration and should be retained in a merged realization under the more evidence-aligned owner terminology. Evaluator-only recommendation; human Product Team authority remains pending.
limitations: The controller-to-repository association lacks a direct graph edge.
Visible pagination is inferred from delivery evidence rather than indexed templates.
The term 'Client record' is not the terminology evidenced by the references.
unsupported_claims: A broader client-record concept beyond owners is not established.
The rendered result-browsing experience is not directly proven.

That runtime rendering in each locale is verified.

limitations: Runtime rendering and translation completeness are not proven.
Only one delivery episode overlaps configuration and localized resources.
